name: Echoes
detailed_description:
ECHOES is a single player game inspired by the sci-fi and horror media of the 1990s

and early 2000s, the Alien movie franchise, and more.

Features

  • Truly immersive first-person gameplay.

  • Make your way through the bowels of the earth using a handheld device. It scans

    your immediate environment with a mounted radar and provides a simple map.

  • Fight back fear and escape whatever has made this place its home as you

    navigate the pitch-black alone.

  • A short experience intended to be completed in less than an hour.

The Gameplay

Set within a supposedly empty mine, your character must find out where the

disembodied voices they seem to be hearing are coming from.

Due to the overwhelming darkness, you can only view your surroundings with the

rudimentary navigational equipment provided to you by your employer. Press the ‘Scan’

button to see where you are – but beware, doing so lets whatever lives in the mine

know you’re there too. Avoid cavernous holes in the ground with help from your map.

The Story

Low on cash, you take a job with the world’s largest resource extraction company. They

send you to the middle of nowhere, to guard the entrance of a mine that was closed

years ago. Easy, right? It was – until you heard the voices. They’re soft, yet persistent.

Your instructions were to stick to your posting and scan the area, so you figure it’s

not out of bounds to venture farther into the mine shaft. After all, there are lightbulbs

strung along the walls to guide your path. But before long the lights go out and you

decide – perhaps unwisely, perhaps not, only time will tell – to keep on going. With only

your company-issued device to guide you, you go deeper.

To survive, you must avoid holes in the cave floor and the things that chase you

whenever you scan what’s in your immediate vicinity. Along the way, you learn who

came before you, why you never heard of them before, and your mysterious connection

to this mine’s past.

short_description: You’re a security guard assigned to protect the entrance to an abandoned mine. You’re not supposed to go beyond your post, but you keep on hearing odd noises coming from within. Investigate their source – and stay alive.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 or AMD Ryzen 3 2200G
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 900 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Designed to run at 720p with low graphics settings.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 9 7900X or Intel i7-12700K
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 900 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Runs at 1080p+ with high settings and post-processing enabled.
